verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, but nothing shows a sandbox, test environment, or mode where registrations avoid real charges. Nothing describes self-serve credential issuance for Registrar either. Having an API is adjacent to this story, not the safe-testing capability it asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get API credentials self-serve and test safely — a sandbox or test environment where registrations don't cost real money
